newsitem.title: GREECE: LLOYD'S REGISTER OFFERS SCHOLARSHIP FOR MARINE-RELATED TECH.
newsitem.headline: LLOYD'S REGISTER OFFERS SCHOLARSHIP FOR MARINE-RELATED TECH.

text.p: LLoyd's register is offering a scholarship for marine-related technologies at a British university to one engineering graduate from a Greek university, the Union of Greek shipowners said in a statement.
The scholarship will be awarded in time to allow the candidate, a Greek national, to attend a course during the coming academic year, it said.
The duration of the scholarship will be one year and the masters degree programme is to be completed in its entirety at a British university, it said.
Applications and documentation should be submitted to the Union of Greek shipowners by October 15 at Akti Miaouli 85, 185 38 Piraeus, attention Eva Tsagli. For queries call the union at 4291-159.
